name: Yash Highvoltage Ltd.
summary: Yash Highvoltage Ltd. manufactures and sells high voltage and high current transformer bushings in India and internationally. It also offers transformer bushings, including oil-impregnated paper (OIP) condenser bushings, resin-impregnated paper (RIP) and resin-impregnated synthetic (RIS) condenser bushings, high voltage and high current bushings, OIP wall bushings, and oil-to-oil bushings. The company also provides specialized services, such as repairing, retrofitting, and replacing old bushings, as well as service consulting. Additionally, it offers OIP condenser, RIP/RIS condenser, as well as invests in share capital. The company was incorporated in 2002 and is based in Vadodara, India.
